records.name: large brown snake
desc: It is about eight feet long.

records.name: jackal
desc: It is a yapping snarling dog, dangerous when in a pack.

records.name: large yellow snake
desc: It is about ten feet long.

records.name: manes
desc: It is a minor but aggressive demon.

records.name: dark elf
desc: An elven figure with jet black skin and white hair, his eyes are large and
twisted with evil.

records.name: brown yeek
desc: It is a strange small humanoid.

records.name: hill orc
desc: He is a hardy well-weathered survivor.

records.name: bandit
desc: He is after your cash!

records.name: dark elven mage
desc: A dark elven figure, dressed all in black, hurling spells at you.

records.name: dark elven warrior
desc: A dark elven figure in armour and ready with his sword.

records.name: gnome mage
desc: A mage of short stature.

records.name: dark elven priest
desc: A dark elven figure, dressed all in black, chanting curses and waiting to
deliver your soul to hell.

records.name: drider
desc: A dark elven torso merged with the bloated form of a giant spider.

records.name: black orc
desc: He is a large orc with powerful arms and deep black skin.

records.name: dark elven lord
desc: A dark elven figure in armour and radiating evil power.

records.name: master rogue
desc: A thief of great power and shifty speed.

records.name: dark elven druid
desc: A powerful dark elf, with mighty nature-controlling enchantments.

records.name: algroth
desc: A powerful troll form.  Venom drips from its needlelike claws.

records.name: ice troll
desc: He is a white troll with powerfully clawed hands.

records.name: ninja
desc: A humanoid clothed in black who moves with blinding speed.

records.name: half-troll
desc: A huge, ugly, half-human in search of plunder.

records.name: skeleton ettin
desc: It is the animated form of a massive two-headed troll.

records.name: water troll
desc: He is a troll that reeks of brine.

records.name: giant grey scorpion
desc: It is a giant grey scorpion.  It looks poisonous.

records.name: dagashi
desc: A human warrior, moving with lightning speed.

records.name: acidic cytoplasm
desc: A disgusting animated blob of destruction.  Flee its gruesome hunger!

records.name: black pudding
desc: A lump of rotting black flesh that slurrrrrrrps across the dungeon floor.

records.name: erinyes
desc: It is a lesser demon of female form; however, she takes little time to show
her true colours.

records.name: eldrak
desc: A massive troll, larger and stronger than many men together.

records.name: ettin
desc: A massive two-headed troll of huge strength, ettins are stupid but violent.
They are also living proof that two heads are not more intelligent than
one...

records.name: knight Templar
desc: It seems that the more devout the person, the more likely they are to cross
the boundary between piety and sanctimoniousness.  And such is the case
with the Order of the Knights Templar; they are among the most pious and
powerful of the religious knightly orders, but noted for their
intolerance.  Thus it is Morgoth's will that is unwittingly done, as the
forces of good are set against each other.

records.name: Medusa, the Gorgon
flags: IM_ACID | IM_FIRE | IM_POIS | NO_CONF | NO_SLEEP | NO_HOLD
desc: One of the original three ugly sisters.  Her face could sink a thousand
ships.  Her scales rattle as she slithers towards you, venom dripping
from her ghastly mouth.

records.name: dark elven sorcerer
desc: A dark elven figure, dressed in deepest black.  Power seems to crackle from
his slender frame.
spells: BLIND | BLINK | WOUND | CONF | DARKNESS | HEAL

records.name: 11-headed hydra
desc: A strange reptilian hybrid with eleven smouldering heads.

records.name: ethereal hound
desc: A pale green hound.  Pulsing red lines and strange fluorescent light hints
at internal organs best left to the imagination.

records.name: The Lernaean Hydra
desc: A massive legendary hydra.  It has twelve powerful heads.  Its many eyes
stare at you as clouds of smoke and poisonous vapour rise from its
seething form.  And it grows new heads as fast as you chop them off.

records.name: The Cat Lord
desc: Master of all things feline, the Cat Lord moves with unsurpassed stealth.

records.name: giant brown tick
desc: It is moving slowly towards you.

records.name: raven
desc: Larger than a crow, and pitch black.

records.name: Polyphemus, the Blind Cyclops
desc: No ordinary cyclops, but the son of a sea-god: he wields the powers of
elemental water as well as the considerable strength of a cyclops.  His
one eye was blinded long ago by the warrior Odysseus, but he has trained
himself to hear so well that it nearly makes up for his disability.

records.name: Atlas, the Titan
flags: HURT_ROCK | IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE | IM_POIS
desc: The strongest of all the Titans.  Legend has it that he used to hold the
sky on his shoulders; and the mountain range that now does so is named
after him.

records.name: Kronos, Lord of the Titans
flags: IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE | IM_POIS | NO_STUN
desc: The lord of the Titans, he has broken loose from his confinement in the
nether hells to seek revenge on the world.

records.name: nighthawk
desc: Trained to hunt and kill without fear.

records.name: aranea
desc: An intelligent arachnid whose hairy legs weave spells in the air.

records.name: elder aranea
desc: A vast, bloated arachnid, master of its brood: among the more terrible of
Ungoliant's descendants, this is a monster such as those who haunted the
dread valley of Nan Dungortheb long ago.
spells: WOUND | DRAIN_MANA | HEAL | HOLD | MIND_BLAST | SLOW

records.name: greater mummy
desc: Once a powerful ruler, now an even more powerful undead menace.
spells: BLIND | WOUND | DARKNESS | DRAIN_MANA | FORGET | HASTE

records.name: lesser Maia
desc: One of the first children of Eru, human-like in form but painfully
beautiful to look upon. You can think of no reason that a servant of Eru
might face you in combat; yet this one stands before you, and its eyes
are ablaze as it prepares its next volley of spells.

records.name: greater Maia
desc: A great Maia whose physical form looks overpowering next
to your own frail body. One of the first children of Eru,
human-like in form but god-like in power. The dungeon
shakes with each of its steps toward you.

records.name: Blue Wizard
flags: IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE | NO_FEAR | SMART
desc: Members of a society of wizards founded by Alatar and Pallandro,
the blue wizards command powerful magics and make formidable opponents.

records.name: Istar
flags: IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE | NO_FEAR | SMART
desc: The Istari are an order of Maia who came to Middle-Earth in the third age.
They have taken the form of human wizards, and channel powerful magic to
crush their foes.

records.name: Arien, Maia of the Sun
desc: The Maia who sails the Sun across the sky has descended into Angband to
kill you. She wears no mortal shell; her body is made of fiery golden
light, painfully bright even when you close your eyes, and hot enough to
melt armor and flesh alike.

records.name: Radagast the Brown
desc: A stocky, smiling man in brown robes, holding in his right hand a
gnarled walking stick. Sent to Middle-Earth by Yavanna, Radagast
has studied the plants and animals of Middle-Earth for many years
and considers himself their defender. His humble robes and demeanor
belie his inner strength.

records.name: Easterling warrior
desc: A warrior of considerable skill.

records.name: healer
desc: A healer of wounds.

records.name: Novice warrior
desc: He looks inexperienced but tough.

records.name: Novice rogue
flags: MALE | EVIL | DROP_60 | OPEN_DOOR | BASH_DOOR | TAKE_ITEM
desc: A rather shifty individual.

records.name: Novice priest
desc: He is tripping over his priestly robes.

records.name: Novice mage
desc: He is leaving behind a trail of dropped spell components.

records.name: Novice ranger
desc: An agile hunter, ready and relaxed.

records.name: Novice paladin
desc: An adventurer both devoutly religious and skillful in combat.

records.name: Swordsman
desc: A warrior of considerable skill.

records.name: Hardened warrior
desc: A scarred warrior who moves with confidence.

records.name: Angel
desc: Who knows why you are now facing an angel as an enemy?  Is it a punishment
from your own god for your sins, or a test of your mettle, or has this angel
been sent by another god on behalf of someone who wishes to claim the glory
for his own god?  Perhaps you will never know: but it is here, and you must
fight it.

records.name: Archangel
desc: An angel protected by an aura of holiness.  Its muscular form looks extremely
powerful next to your own frail body.

records.name: Cherub
flags: SMART | DROP_2 | MOVE_BODY | IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE
desc: It is an angel moving very quickly, wielding a holy war hammer and casting a
volley of powerful spells in your direction.
spells: BLIND | HASTE | HEAL | MIND_BLAST | SCARE | BO_FIRE | S_MONSTERS

records.name: Seraph
flags: SMART | DROP_2 | MOVE_BODY | IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE | NO_FEAR
desc: It is an angel, fast and strong.  You are stunned by its extreme holiness and
try to resist all desires to obey it.
spells: CONF | HASTE | HEAL | TELE_AWAY | BO_MANA | BO_PLAS | S_AINU | S_MONSTERS

records.name: Archon
flags: SMART | ATTR_FLICKER | DROP_4 | DROP_GOOD | MOVE_BODY | IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE | NO_FEAR
desc: Never a more heavenly being have you seen.  The very holiness of its presence
makes you deeply respect it.  Few creatures can match the powers of an
Archon; fewer still live to tell the tale after attacking one.
spells: BLIND | WOUND | SCARE | TELE_TO | BO_MANA | S_AINU

records.name: Uriel, Angel of Fire
flags: UNIQUE | MALE | SMART | DROP_4 | DROP_GOOD | MOVE_BODY | IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE | IM_PLASMA
desc: A creature of godly appearance, you dare not challenge Uriel's supremacy.
Those who stood against him before are but a memory, cremated by his mastery
of elemental fire.
spells: BLIND | TELE_TO | BA_FIRE | BO_FIRE | BO_MANA | BO_PLAS | BR_FIRE | BR_PLAS | S_AINU

records.name: Azriel, Angel of Death
flags: UNIQUE | MALE | SMART | DROP_4 | DROP_GOOD | MOVE_BODY | IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE
desc: Azriel commands awesome power, his visage holy enough to shrivel your soul.
You shriek with disbelief as his mastery of death draws you to your grave.
It is truly beyond all but the mightiest of warriors to stand against him and
live.
spells: BLIND | TELE_TO | BA_NETH | BO_MANA | BO_NETH | BR_NETH | S_AINU

records.name: Gabriel, the Messenger
flags: UNIQUE | MALE | SMART | DROP_4 | DROP_GOOD | MOVE_BODY | IM_ACID | IM_COLD | IM_ELEC | IM_FIRE
desc: Commanding a legion of angels, Gabriel will destroy you for your sins.  He
will crush you like the pitiful insignificant being he sees you to be.  Your
very soul will be taken into judgement by his supreme authority as he
cleanses the world of evil.
